data.text: 2026-11-16: Owner saw vanilla music toast (NowPlayingToast, separate instance, untouched by Smooth Toasts) still on the left. Fixed in mc-spotify 1.0.2+26.3 (~/dev/mc-spotify, not git; pre-change backup in session scratchpad mc-spotify-backup.tgz): mixin cancels ToastManager.showNowPlayingToast and, if options.musicToast renderToast(), shows the track ("Artist - Title" from MusicManager.getCurrentMusicTranslationKey) in the shared TrackToast (music-notes icon instead of cover) -> lands in the Smooth Toasts deck. Verified in isolated client (entrypoint-stripped copy to avoid AppleScript prompts while Spotify runs). Installed 1.0.2, 1.0.1 renamed .disabled. Gotcha: `pgrep -fl java` prints the game's full launch line incl. the MC access token; use `pgrep -f ... >/dev/null` or `pgrep -l` instead.
